lines: {target}? Sound itself can <shake>wake trouble</shake>.
If someone goes to Ancient City, tell them this. <pulse>Step softly</pulse> and leave the shiny things alone.

{target}? Bridges hang over lava and worse things patrol them.

{target}? A little shelter can keep a strange secret below.
